title: Fault reset
remedy: Informative

title: Current calibration
cause: Current offset/gain calibration will occur at next start
remedy: Informative warning (ID run requested)

title: Overcurrent
remedy: Check load, ramps, scaling, wiring, insulation

title: Earth leakage
cause: Load unbalance typically due to earth fault in motor/cable
remedy: Check for earth fault; measure insulation resistance; remove PF capacitors/surge absorbers; try scalar mode; contact ABB if persists

title: Short circuit
cause: Short‑circuit in motor cable or motor
remedy: Check motor/cable for wiring errors; remove PF capacitors/surge absorbers

title: IGBT overload
cause: Excessive IGBT temperature; may be caused by motor cable short
remedy: Check motor cable; ambient; airflow; fan; heatsink dust; motor vs drive rating

title: DC link overvoltage
cause: DC bus voltage too high when stopped
remedy: Check supply voltage setting; verify correct supply voltage

title: DC link undervoltage
cause: DC bus voltage too low when stopped
remedy: Check supply voltage; incorrect setting may cause uncontrolled motor rush

title: DC not charged
cause: DC bus voltage not yet at operating level
remedy: Check affected module via auxiliary code; contact ABB if persistent

title: Motor cable overload
cause: Calculated motor cable temperature exceeded limit
remedy: Check parameters 35.61/35.62; verify cable sizing

title: Incorrect temperature sensor setup
remedy: Check parameters 35.11–35.24; check sensor wiring; correct sensor type

title: External temperature 1
remedy: Check parameter 35.02; check cooling; check warning limit 35.13

title: External temperature 2
remedy: Check parameter 35.03; check cooling; check warning limit 35.23

title: Motor temperature 1
remedy: Check motor cooling; load; wiring; sensor resistance; replace sensor if faulty

title: Motor temperature 2
remedy: Same corrective actions as A497

title: Motor temperature 3
remedy: Same corrective actions as A497

title: Control board temperature
remedy: Check ambient; airflow; fan; heatsink dust; replace control unit if thermistor broken

title: IGBT overtemperature
remedy: Check ambient, airflow, fan, heatsink

title: Cooling
remedy: Check ambient; derating; airflow; fan; cabinet dust; clean if needed

title: Excess temperature
remedy: Check ambient; airflow; fan; heatsink dust; motor vs drive rating; use auxiliary code to locate sensor

title: Excess temperature difference
remedy: Check motor cabling; cooling; use auxiliary code to identify phase/module

title: PCB space cooling
remedy: Check PCB space cooling fan; use auxiliary code for module identification

title: IGBT temperature
remedy: Check ambient; airflow; fan; heatsink dust; motor vs drive rating

title: PU communication
cause: Communication errors between control unit and power unit
remedy: Check connections; use auxiliary code to identify transmission error type

title: Fan
remedy: Check parameter 95.20; use auxiliary code to identify fan; inspect/replace fan

title: Auxiliary fan missing
remedy: Check auxiliary fans; replace if faulty; ensure front cover installed

title: Safe torque off
remedy: Check STO wiring; verify safety circuit connections

title: Measurement circuit temperature
remedy: Use auxiliary code to identify sensor location; inspect cooling

title: PU board powerfail
remedy: Contact ABB

title: PU communication internal
remedy: Check control‑to‑power unit connections

title: Measurement circuit ADC
remedy: Contact ABB

title: Measurement circuit DFF
remedy: Contact ABB

title: PU state feedback
remedy: Contact ABB

title: Charging feedback
remedy: Informative; wait until charging completes

title: Switching frequency below requested
cause: Requested output frequency cannot be met
remedy: Informative warning

title: Control unit battery
remedy: Replace battery; can suppress via parameter 31.40

title: Flash erase speed exceeded
remedy: Avoid unnecessary saves; check auxiliary code for subsector number

title: Data saving to power unit
remedy: Cycle power; reboot control unit; contact ABB if persistent

title: SD card
remedy: Insert writable SD card; remove write protection; replace unreadable card

title: Checksum mismatch
remedy: Enable correct reference checksums; verify configuration; update checksum

title: Checksum configuration
cause: Checksum mismatch action defined but not configured
remedy: Contact ABB or disable feature

title: Parameter map configuration
cause: Too much data in mapping table
remedy: Reduce mapping table size; refer to Drive Customizer manual

title: Mapped parameter value cut
cause: Parameter value saturated due to scaling
remedy: Adjust scaling/format in mapping table

title: Motor nominal value
cause: Motor parameters incorrect or drive incorrectly sized
remedy: Check motor parameters (groups 98/99); verify drive sizing

title: No motor data
remedy: Enter all required motor data in group 99

title: Supply voltage unselected
remedy: Set parameter 95.01

title: System time not set
remedy: Set system time

title: User lock open
remedy: Close user lock via invalid pass code in 96.02

title: User pass code not confirmed
remedy: Enter same code in 96.101 to confirm

title: FBA A parameter conflict
remedy: Check PLC programming; check FBA settings

title: FBA B parameter conflict
remedy: Check PLC programming; check FBA settings

title: Reference source parametrization
cause: Reference source connected to multiple parameters with different units
remedy: Check reference source selections; use auxiliary code to identify conflict

title: AI parametrization
remedy: Adjust hardware setting or parameter 12.15/12.25; reboot control board

title: ULC configuration
remedy: Correct speed/frequency/overload/underload point ordering

title: Motor stall
remedy: Check motor load; drive rating; stall function parameters

title: Motor fan
remedy: Check external fan; check parameters 35.100–35.106

title: FEN temperature
cause: Temperature sensor error on encoder interface
remedy: Check temperature source settings; check encoder module activation; use PTC if FEN‑01

title: Motor overload
remedy: Check overload parameters

title: Motor disconnect
remedy: Check motor wiring

title: Brake resistor
remedy: Check resistor connection and condition

title: BR excess temperature
remedy: Stop drive; cool resistor; check overload protection; check warning limit; verify resistor sizing

title: BR data
remedy: Correct parameters 43.08–43.10 based on auxiliary code

title: BC IGBT excess temp
remedy: Cool, check fan, cabinet, resistor

title: Mechanical brake opening failed
remedy: Check brake wiring/settings

title: Extension I/O config failure
remedy: Check module type

title: FBA A communication
remedy: Check fieldbus wiring/settings

title: EFB comm loss
remedy: Check RS485 wiring

title: Panel loss
remedy: Check panel connection

title: Cooling fan
remedy: Replace fan

title: AI supervision
remedy: Check wiring, signal level

title: RO life warning
remedy: Replace relay

title: Checksum mismatch
cause: Actual checksum does not match approved checksum
remedy: Informative
